summary: ANVISA Tab Card-Based Layout v4 - All features tested successfully. Backend: 11/11 tests passed. Frontend: Card layout with prominent medicine names, Buscar Licitações buttons, and navigation all working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: VERIFIED: Card-based layout shows medicine names prominently in large, bold UPPERCASE text
VERIFIED: Each card has a prominent 'Buscar Licitações' button (blue, right side)
VERIFIED: Clicking 'Buscar Licitações' navigates to Pesquisa tab, fills search field with medicine name
VERIFIED: Stats badges at top show: total_alertas, janelas_abertas (red), risco_alto, importação counts
VERIFIED: Each card shows tipo_alerta tag, risco level badge, fonte tag, and indice % badge
VERIFIED: 'Atualizar' button triggers the ANVISA+DOU scraper
VERIFIED: Medicine names include clean single names (TIRZEPATIDA, KEFADIM, CANABIDIOL) and descriptive names for general alerts
VERIFIED: data-testid attributes working: tab-anvisa, anvisa-dashboard, anvisa-alerta-{idx}, anvisa-med-nome-{idx}, anvisa-buscar-{idx}, anvisa-atualizar-btn

seed_data_creation: 25 alerts present in MongoDB from ANVISA+DOU scraping
context_for_next_testing_agent: ANVISA card-based layout tested. Key features: (1) Medicine names in large uppercase in card headers, (2) 'Buscar Licitações' button on each card navigates to search with pre-filled term, (3) Stats badges at top (Alertas, Janelas Abertas, Risco Alto, Importação), (4) Each card shows tipo_alerta, risco, fonte, indice% tags. Currently 25 alerts with 12 having clean single-word medicine names. Backend extracts single medicine names from ANVISA titles when possible.
